title: Bayer Foundation: Fellowship for STEM Student Teachers & Teachers
summary: Fellowship providing up to 10,000 EUR for up to 12 months for STEM student teachers and teachers undertaking internships, professional development, or research projects in Germany or abroad.

degree_levels.notes: Students pursuing a teaching degree or a degree in education (Bachelor's, Master's, Ph.D., state examination) with a focus on STEM subjects.

nationality.notes: Country selection lists numerous countries, but no specific explicit nationality restrictions are detailed in the extracted text beyond the residence requirement in Germany and the dynamic portal list.

residence.notes: Open exclusively to applicants who are currently working or studying in Germany.

mandatory.text: Currently working or studying in Germany
Pursuing a teaching degree or a degree in education (Bachelor's, Master's, Ph.D., state examination) OR qualified teacher with up to 10 years of professional experience
Activities must have a clear connection to Trust in Science

funding.description: Individual financial support, limited to 10,000 EUR per request.

application_rounds.notes: Please find the updated deadlines for application on the external provider website.

steps.text: Find application forms and further information on the application procedure on the Bayer Foundation website.
